release_name: Live TV v4.0.1 — Notification Polish, Phone Quick Controls & Favorites Sync
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 🚨 Goal & Wicket Notification Fix: Sports celebration flash notifications now auto-dismiss cleanly after 6s and can be instantly dismissed with 1-click on the ✕ close button. Eliminates distortion and prevents repeat alerts triggered purely by the match clock

📱 Phone Remote Quick Controls Reordered: Reorganized phone player tool buttons to Quality ➔ Full Screen ➔ PiP ➔ Lock ➔ Audio ➔ Fit ➔ Radio ➔ Speed ➔ Sleep ➔ Dim so the most essential controls are immediately accessible without scrolling

⭐ Full Mac & Phone Favorites Synchronization: Ranked favorites (#1, #2, #3, ...) now seamlessly synchronize in real-time between Mac and Phone Remote across both the Channels catalog and the phone player's Quick Channels carousel
